title: Fluffy pancakes
steps: Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt in a large bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the milk, egg and melted butter.
Pour the wet mix into the dry and stir until just combined. A few lumps are fine.
Let the batter rest for 5 minutes.
Heat a lightly oiled pan over medium heat. Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake.
Cook about 2 minutes, until bubbles form, then flip and cook 1 minute more.

title: Simple tomato pasta
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Warm the olive oil in a pan and cook the garlic for 1 minute, without browning.
Add the tomatoes and salt. Simmer for 15 minutes, stirring now and then.
Meanwhile cook the pasta for 10 minutes, or as the package says.
Drain the pasta, toss it with the sauce, and top with basil and Parmesan.

title: Roast chicken
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Pat the chicken dry. Rub all over with butter, salt and pepper.
Put the halved lemon, garlic and thyme inside the chicken.
Roast for 75 minutes, until the juices run clear.
Rest the chicken for 10 minutes before carving.

title: Chocolate chip cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Beat the butter and both sugars until creamy. Beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking soda and salt, then the chocolate chips.
Drop spoonfuls onto a baking sheet, 2 inches apart.
Bake for 10 minutes, until golden at the edges.
Cool on the sheet for 2 minutes, then move to a rack.
